identity.name: Datejust 36
identity.one_liner: The current Datejust 36 with a white-gold fluted bezel and caliber 3235, introduced 2018.

narrative.story: The 126234 updated the steel Datejust 36 in 2018 with the 3235 and a subtly reshaped case. The fluted bezel is white gold on a steel case — the Rolesor formula the Datejust has used for decades. Dial choice drives this market more than the reference itself: palm motif, azzurro blue, and mother-of-pearl options each trade differently.
narrative.collector_notes: Available in many dial and bracelet permutations; Jubilee with the fluted bezel is the classic spec. Datejusts are usually obtainable at retail with patience, so grey premiums are thin.
